useIndex.description:
If True, then the indices of `targetOutput`, `modelOutput`, and `context` are used for score
calculation.

batchSize.description:
If the provided data does not fit in memory, then use this value as batch size to iterate through and compute incremental
metrics on batches of data.

title:
{@link MlMeanIouMetric} computes the Intersection Over Union between two lists of {@link BoundingBox},
one being the output of an Object Detection Model and the other being the ground truth.
It is expected that the two lists share cardinality and ordinality.
If this is not the case, see {@link MlAsymmetricMeanIOUMetric}.
name: MlMeanIouMetric
